title: Data Alone Is Not Enough: The Evolution of Data Architectures

reader_summary.headline: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast. It's long been a buzzword in the industry, whether big data, streaming data, data, data analytics, data science, even AI and machine learning. It takes an entire system of tools and technology to extract value from data.

key_points.text: A multi-billion dollar industry has emerged around these data tools and technologies, and with so much excitement and innovation in the space.
key_points.evidence_quote: A multi-billion dollar industry has emerged around these data tools and technologies, and with so much excitement and innovation in the space, it raises the question, how exactly do all these tools fit together?

key_points.text: This podcast, featuring Ali Goetze, the CEO and founder of Databricks, explores the evolution of data architect, including some quick history, where they're going.
key_points.evidence_quote: This podcast, featuring Ali Goetze, the CEO and founder of Databricks, explores the evolution of data architect, including some quick history, where they're going, and a surprising use case for streaming data, as well as Ollie's take on how heat architect the picks and shovels that handle data end-to-end today.

key_points.text: Joining Ali in this hallway-style jam is A16Z general partner Martine Casado, who, with other A16Z enterprise partners.
key_points.evidence_quote: Joining Ali in this hallway-style jam is A16Z general partner Martine Casado, who, with other A16Z enterprise partners, just published a series of blueprints for the modern data stack.
